title: bench-hpc ExecutionRequest v2
description: Agent-facing unit of work identified by (run_id, operation_id, attempt). Pure argv, digest-pinned runtime, content-addressed inputs, relative outputs, typed resources. Raw scheduler flags, shell strings, and mutable tags are rejected by construction.

operation_id.description: Stable logical identity of the operation within the run.

attempt.description: Scientific retry counter; monotonic per operation, no gaps, one in flight.

runtime.description: A runtime capability name (cp2k, ai2kit, deepmd-jax, ...); trusted infra resolves it to a locked SIF digest. The digest-pinned name@sha256:<64 hex> form is accepted only as a hidden compatibility path and is verified against the lock.

command.description: argv only, no empty entries. A single shell string is rejected by construction.

environment.description: Allowlisted at the runtime-wrapper layer; values must be strings.

path.description: Run-workspace-relative path; no absolute paths, backslashes, or '..'.

inputs.description: Content-addressed input snapshot; staging re-verifies every entry.

outputs.description: Run-relative declared outputs; explicit fetch is required to enter the submission.
